result.instructions: Tools for Shiftavo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which shifts are scheduled at our Amsterdam location next week?"; "Show the confirmed timesheets from 1 to 7 November."; "What is the labor cost for all locations from 1 to 31 December?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Shiftavo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shiftavo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shiftavo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shiftavo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shiftavo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

end.description: Only shifts that start before this date-time.

location.description: Only records of this location id (UUID).

position.description: Only records of this position id (UUID).

tools.name: shiftavo_get_labor_cost
tools.title: Get labor cost
tools.description: Gets the labor-cost projection for a date range, optionally for some locations. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /labor_cost/ (scope labor_cost.read).

start.description: First day of the projection, ISO 8601 date, for example 2026-12-01.

end.description: Last day of the projection, ISO 8601 date, inclusive. Must be on or after start.

location.description: Location ids (UUID) to include. Omit for every location.
